page.overview:
What is Broc Coli Island?

Broc Coli Island is an island in the New World.

A war-struck land, fighting on Broc Coli Island was fueled by Donquixote Doflamingo's weapons trade, and later concluded by the hiring of Germa 66.

The island is very heavily forested, with the tallest trees resembling broccoli, giving the island its name. There exists at least one big city that has been damaged by war. Several of these tall, broccoli-shaped trees can be seen scattered across the island, alongside giant mounds and cliffs.

It is located about two days away from Whole Cake Island when traveling by ship.
